# `gcp.alloydb.user`

A database user in an AlloyDB cluster.

| Service | alloydb |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `alloydb.googleapis.com/User` |

| Tier | 1 (ruled: pre_update (pre_update/alloydb_user.go.tmpl) adds password to the body and mask when Terraform's password_wo_version changes, because a write-only attribute never reaches Terraform's diff. Here password is an ordinary input-only, sensitive attribute, carried forward: a changed password is a changed leaf, masked like any other. custom_import only parses `terraform import`'s id.
